title: Boswellia serrata cream for medicinal use
intro: Boswellia serrata cream is a topical preparation made from the resin of the Boswellia serrata tree, commonly known as Indian frankincense. It is widely used in herbalism for its anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties. The cream is applied directly to the skin to relieve pain and reduce inflammation associated with conditions like arthritis and muscle strains. It is valued for its natural composition and minimal side effects compared to synthetic medications. Herbal practitioners often recommend it as a complementary therapy for chronic pain management.
